name: code-quality
description: 4 skills for code and documentation quality: lint-and-validate (mandatory pre-commit gate with auto-fix formatters and linters), api-design-principles (REST/GraphQL enforcement, RFC 7807), openapi-spec-generation (keep OpenAPI 3.1 spec in sync), doc-coauthoring (ADRs, design docs, runbooks, postmortems). lint-and-validate is also in essentials.
